Workload mix: real-time streaming to IDE for single-dev sessions + batch reranking for CI-based PR scan (nightly).
Latency target: interactive streaming <100ms token median for US, <150ms EU acceptable for initial rollouts.
Throughput: peak bursts 80 concurrent users during team-wide code reviews; typical sustained 10-15 qps for model inference.
